The undeniable tailwinds fueling SaaS companies have led to lofty valuation multiples historically, but rich prices also make re-ratings harder and place a ceiling on returns - over the past six months, the industry’s 5.3% gain has lagged the S&P 500 by 5.2 percentage points.

content.title: 1 Small-Cap Stock with Promising Prospects and 2 We Brush Off
